title: Flatness of constants in finite-variable power series
statement: For a Noetherian commutative ring $B$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $n\geq0$, the constants homomorphism $B\to B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Tag 0EYA first paragraph; Tag 00MB, completion flatness

proof.text:
The polynomial ring in finitely many variables over B is Noetherian.
Its completion for the ideal generated by the variables is the power-series
ring: modulo the kth power both rings are the polynomials of total degree
less than k, and a compatible family of truncations specifies each coefficient.
Noetherian adic completion is flat (00MB). The polynomial ring is free over B,
with its monomial basis, hence flat. Compose these two flat maps and identify
their composite with C by its action on constants. This includes n = 0,
where C is an isomorphism, and the zero ring.
